caption: ISM Services PMI diffusion index (vermillion, left axis) against SPY price (blue, right axis), 1997–2025. The 50 line marks services expansion versus contraction; green markers show months when the winner's rolling z-score weakness trigger fires. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: Hero makes the countercyclical rule visually legible: buy when services sentiment is unusually weak, while the caption discloses that Granger evidence is reverse-only.
